## About

Innovate and Amplify is a one-person web development and AI automation studio in
Spokane, WA, started in 2024 by Austin Harrison. It builds websites, AI workflows,
and marketing systems for small businesses and creators. Clients work directly with
Austin; there are no account managers or agency layers.

## Founder

Austin Harrison, founder and developer
Phone: +1 (425) 582-1003
Email: contact@innovateandamplify.com
Website: https://innovateandamplify.com

## Services

- Web Development: Custom web applications built with React, Next.js, and Node.js.
  Responsive design and online stores.
- AI Automation: Workflow automation, AI agents and assistants, API integrations,
  and internal tooling built for business-specific workflows.
- Digital Marketing: SEO, social media strategy, analytics, and campaign management
  aimed at turning visitors into customers.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2024
- Studio type: one person
- Location: Spokane, WA
- Client websites live: 3 (Evergreen Rain Gutters, MICRIST Environmental, SP-Archives)
- Products in beta: 1 (Starlit Stories)
- Every project is built by the founder, Austin Harrison
- Published results: none yet; the three client sites are live and linked below
- Primary clients: Local service businesses
- Business hours: Mon to Fri 9 AM to 6 PM, Sat 10 AM to 4 PM (US Pacific)

## Selected work

- Evergreen Rain Gutters (client, Spokane): website with an on-site AI assistant and instant lead alerts to the owner: https://evergreenrainguttersllc.com
- MICRIST Environmental (client, Washington): website with a course catalog, online payments, and a client-edited CMS: https://micristenviro.com
- SP-Archives (client, photographer Skyelar Payne, Pacific Northwest and North Idaho): photography archive website with session inquiries: https://sp-archives.com
- Starlit Stories (own product, in beta): personalized children's storybook generator (React, Azure, OpenAI)
